rule.context_history: one actual baseline command and two observed joint positions
rule.context_support: closed per-condition coordinate minima/maxima of the four training features; no padding
rule.condition_default: complete four-start controller ranked by whole-episode quality, then action index
rule.retrieval: current command phase/contact and scaled state distance; immutable condition-filtered cases
rule.selection: highest predicted quality, then action index; retain a supported previous action unless gain reaches 0.001 m/s
